3109d080d2613ed01f1459ac88244706dce591d1.summary: Unit 42 (Palo Alto Networks) reports a campaign it tracks as CL-UNK-1211, observed from October 2025 to April 2026, targeting government entities and state-affiliated infrastructure on Linux servers and databases. The attackers used web shells, credential harvesting, a custom Go remote access Trojan named SysGoRAT, reverse shells, SSH and database pivoting, mailbox searches for social media account access, and anti-forensics such as log deletion and timestomping. The report says the code shows signs of AI generation, and whether the actor is nation-state or cybercrime is not yet determined.
